title: Prandtl bearing capacity on level ground

meta.title: Prandtl bearing capacity on level ground
meta.notes: Weightless (γ = 1e-6 kN/m³) c = 20 kPa soil (φ = 0) loaded by a strip load of 102.83 kPa = c·(2 + π) over 10 m, the exact bearing capacity. Analyzed on the Prandtl mechanism of Fig. 26.2: active wedge under the load, a 90° fan arc of radius 7.071 m about the load's edge (5, 10), lowest point 2.929, and the passive wedge.

source.reference: Prandtl (1920). Über die Härte plastischer Körper. Nachr. Ges. Wiss. Göttingen, Math.-phys. Kl., 74–85.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V077 (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Theoretical factor of safety 1.0; limit equilibrium with slices gives 6 % less on this mechanism (commercial program A and cSlope alike).
program D 1.043 on an earlier transcription whose fan was a single kink at (5, 3.9645).
Unit weight 1e-6 kN/m³ as in commercial program A's Table 26.1 (was 0.01; the result is the same to four decimals).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.

slope.direction fijado a left_to_right por el importador (DIRECTION_OVERRIDES): terreno plano y una polilínea simétrica con los dos extremos a la misma cota, así que auto no tiene pista; cSlope toma ltr con crestas iguales (infer_orientation_from_coordinates) y el oráculo da el mismo FS con ltr y con rtl.
